name: rsi_divergence_vwap_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP selling programs execute in size bursts separated by absorption pauses: the index makes a new 1-minute low yet RSI (measuring momentum velocity, not price) fails to confirm because resting buy orders at each lower tick partially absorb the selling. This momentum-price divergence signals that the marginal seller is nearly exhausted. When NIFTY is also within 0.15% below session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms — which receive adverse fills below their benchmark — begin accelerating accumulation, creating a 30-90 second demand surge that reverts price toward VWAP. The entry fires at the moment the divergence is detectable (2-minute window comparison) while the demand response is just beginning.
core_signal_oneliner: Price makes a lower low over 2 minutes but RSI makes a higher low, signaling seller exhaustion while price is just below VWAP
